title: Introduce reconnect dampener and telemetry retry presets for Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customer workloads observed bursty reconnect storms during transient network blips which amplify downstream load and cause cascading autoscaler churn. This PR introduces a lightweight 'reconnect dampener' at the SDK level plus a family of telemetry-friendly retry presets to give teams predictable, observable reconnect/backoff behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Goals: 1) prevent reconnect storms by adding jittered holdoff + soft-capacity-aware dampening; 2) provide documented retry presets (fast/standard/steady) that wire telemetry hooks for retry counters and sampled backoff traces; 3) smooth cross-SDK ergonomics for streaming APIs (abort signals, optional resume token hints) and ship coordinated version bumps. What this changes (high level): added ReconnectDampener primitive in all three SDKs; central RetryProfile enum + presets exported from root package; telemetry hooks that emit retry_reason and backoff_ms (sampled) to tracing and metrics; streaming client changes: add optional ResumeHint on reconnect, expose AbortController/Context-friendly cancel APIs; bumped SDK versions (py->1.13.0, ts->2.0.1, go->1.5.4). Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1984) - [x] unit tests for dampener + backoff math - [x] end-to-end smoke against staging runtime - [x] coordinated changelogs and SDK version bumps - [x] CI green after flake fixes Notes: telemetry emission is opt-in by default (env var or client config). Backwards compatibility: default RetryProfile preserves prior behavior; opt-in presets enable smoother production defaults. Rollout: small canary clients for 48h with sampled telemetry before wider release. See related: ENG-1984, SUP-4321 for incident context.

release_notes: Introduce reconnect dampener (opt-in) and three retry presets (fast/standard/steady); improved streaming ergonomics (resume hints + cancel API); telemetry hooks for retry/backoff sampling; version bumps: Python 1.13.0, TypeScript 2.0.1, Go 1.5.4.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover dampener edge cases (zero jitter, max holdoff), added integration test that simulates transient network flaps; staging smoke validated no autoscaler spike on canary clients.
impact_analysis: Low risk by default: defaults preserve previous retry behavior. Opt-in presets recommended for high-throughput clients. Telemetry opt-in avoids accidental metric noise. Server-side runtime compatibility verified for resume_hint semantics.
